text.introText: Tell us the loaf, pastry or service you'd love to see at {name}, or back an idea someone else had. The most-wanted ideas make it to the oven first.
text.detailsPlaceholder: Tell us more: flavours, dietary needs, when you'd want it
text.emptyList: The oven is empty. Be the first to suggest something!
text.firstToSuggest: Nobody has asked for this yet. Tell a friend; every vote moves it closer to the oven.
